methodology: Static code analysis + runtime simulation + concurrency testing

file_evidence.finding: Global instance activation_addition_runtime has empty _vectors dict at import time
No code calls load_vector_from_safetensors() during startup
_apply_activation_addition returns (None, 0.0) when params has no 'vector' key
No code loads activation vectors before passing request to processor

claim_1_activation_addition.root_cause: Vectors are never loaded from artifacts. The runtime infrastructure exists but is never populated. No startup code, no API code, no request processing code loads vectors.
claim_1_activation_addition.impact: Activation addition is completely non-functional. Requests with activation_addition config produce zero intervention.

file_evidence.finding: Global instance conceptor_runtime has empty _conceptors dict
_apply_conceptor returns (None, 0.0) when params missing basis_vectors/singular_values
No code loads conceptor artifacts during startup

claim_2_conceptor_steering.root_cause: Conceptors are never loaded from artifacts. No .safetensors conceptor files exist. The runtime infrastructure is empty.
claim_2_conceptor_steering.impact: Conceptor steering is completely non-functional. Zero conceptor artifacts exist on disk.

file_evidence.finding: DExpertsController class exists but is never instantiated in runtime path
NRAMLogitProcessor has no DExperts-related methods or logic
No code wires DExperts configuration from request to processor
NRAMRequestControlPlane does not instantiate DExpertsController

claim_3_dexperts.root_cause: DExpertsController is defined but never instantiated. The logit processor has no DExperts logic. API routes do not wire DExperts config.
claim_3_dexperts.impact: DExperts is completely unwired. Expert model loading, logit combination, and anti-expert logic never execute.

file_evidence.finding: _generate_branch returns empty text when generator_fn is None
_default_generation_fn returns placeholder text '[branch_X_generated_text]'
No code wires BranchAndTournamentGenerator to real model generation

claim_4_branch_tournament.root_cause: Branch tournament uses placeholder generator that returns fake text. No real model generation occurs. API routes do not connect tournament to SGLang engine.
claim_4_branch_tournament.impact: Branch-and-tournament produces placeholder text, not real model output. Tournament scoring operates on empty/fake data.

claim_5_request_isolation.claim: Request isolation works with batched execution

file_evidence.finding: Uses threading.local() for request context storage
get_current_context_for_batch() just wraps thread-local, not batch-aware

thread_test.description: 4 concurrent threads, each with own request context
thread_test.details: Each thread got its own context correctly

async_test.description: 4 concurrent async tasks on same thread
async_test.details: Task 0 saw task 3's context (async-req-3), tasks 1-3 got null (race condition)

claim_5_request_isolation.root_cause: Thread-local storage is NOT safe for async execution. SGLang uses asyncio, not threading. All async tasks share the same thread-local, causing cross-contamination and race conditions.
claim_5_request_isolation.impact: Request isolation is broken for async batched execution. Interventions from one request can leak to another. Race conditions cause contexts to be null or wrong.

file_evidence.finding: NRAMLogitProcessor has no coherence measurement or enforcement logic
coherence_floor is a profile parameter but not wired to runtime enforcement
compile_policy maps coherence_floor -> min_coherence but min_coherence is unused
Only module mentioning coherence enforcement, but not wired to processor

claim_6_coherence_floor.root_cause: coherence_floor is a decorative parameter. It exists in profiles and is compiled to min_coherence, but no runtime code measures or enforces coherence. The logit processor has no coherence logic.
claim_6_coherence_floor.impact: coherence_floor has no effect on generation. It is accepted as a parameter but never used. No coherence measurement occurs during inference.

testing_methodology: Static code analysis of runtime paths
Concurrency testing with threads and async
key_findings: All 6 claims from Forensic Reviewer (Phase 10 TRUE) are CONFIRMED BROKEN
Activation addition and conceptor steering have infrastructure but no data loading
DExperts is completely unwired - controller never instantiated
Branch-and-tournament uses placeholder generators returning fake text
Request isolation uses thread-local which is unsafe for async (SGLang's execution model)
coherence_floor is a decorative parameter with no runtime enforcement
summary.recommendation: All 6 defects require remediation before release. Features are non-functional.
